batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c AA Chavan b SW Tait

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c DH Yagnik b SW Tait

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c MJ Clarke b WD Parnell

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c SPD Smith b B Kumar

batting.name: AL Menaria
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b MJ Clarke

balls.text: full toss on middle to finish,worked towards midwicket for a single, just three off the last over, ties for the most economical final over this season, Pune end on 125 for 6
nudged towards backward square leg for a single
143kph high full toss just over the stumps, smith had moved across but he couldn't get bat on it,the umpire correctly deems that it wasn't above waist high

short of length ball that is top-edged towards square leg, Tait had to race towards it  as there's no fielder close in, the keeper was also after it, Tait is closer to it but even after his sprint he can't get to it, Parnell survives
Tait does what he does best, a full fast yorker, 143 kph, Manhas aimed an ambitious hit towards long-on, that ball was too good for him, it lasers into the base of off stump, Tait has 3-10 now
a full all outside off, 140kph, Manhas had moved so far outside off that he couldn't connect with that one, it slides between him and the stumps to the keeper
full, 139 kph ball to finish, can't get under that one, the ball dribbles to the leg side, batsmen scamper a single
moves across the stumps, quicker this one 141 kph, hits the pads outside off and rolls towards fine leg
full and that is punched towards deep midwicket for a single
short and wide, 114kph from Watson, would have been wide if the batsman had let it go, a back-of-the-hand slower ball attempted, but Watson loses his line, thrashed towards the point boundary
127kph offcutter from Watson, thumped towards square leg for a single
full ball is drilled towards long-off, again the boundaries are proving elusive
Smith wanted two again after whipping a full ball towards deep square leg, but it was too well hit to have time for two
no pace at all from Trivedi, 102kph, short of length and on the pads, pushed to the right of the bowler for two, great running there
Smith can't time it, he 's having a bit of struggle out there, this time the ball loops towards mid-off for a single
short of length and heading down leg, off the pads towards gully, inside-edge there from Manhas
back of a length ball is clipped towards midwicket, Smith sets off the second but Manhas isn't interested

Smith survives, that spent a long time in the air after he mishit it towards mid-off, neither the man from long-off nor the fielder from cover could get there in time, no matter though as Owais Shah fires in the throw to catch out Mathews, who was scrambling for the second
another slower one, 106.5kph, short and just outside off, Smith waits an age for it to arrive and pulls towards square leg
thumped towards extra cover for a single
length slower ball, back of the hand, 104kph, Mathews throws his bat at it but can't connect
tipped towards backward point for a single
135.4kph down the leg side, Smith needed to get some bat on it to get it past the keeper for four, Smith screams in frustration at missing out
full and slanting towards leg stump, clipped towards deep midwicket
pitched up on middle and leg, whipped towards midwicket by Mathews, but can't find the gap
eased towards long-on for one more, eight off the over and it's time for the timeout
full and on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg, a lazy bit of fielding from Trivedi gives away an extra run, Botha suggests the fielder should have tried stopping that with both hands
between midwicket and long-on for a single
tips it in the direction of point and sets off, there was no run in that, as Mathews decided, so Smith had to scramble back
another leading edge, back towards the bowler, Botha dives to left to stop that, well done Botha
Botha bowls it full, Smith gets his front leg out of the way, then times it to the sweeper cover boundary, terrific stroke from Smith
a leading edge sends the ball towards extra cover, one more single, just four off the over, Binny's had a good day so far
length ball outside off, 109kph, guided towards backward point for one more
length ball is clipped towards deep square leg for one more
fuller and on leg stump, eased towards long-on for a single
another dot ball as Mathews drives to cover
short of length ball, 120 kph, and that is pushed towards cover, no run
slower from Botha as he gives it more air, Smith goes for the sweep but misses, Botha asks for the lbw but the umpire turns it down, struck in front of middle but looked headed down leg
full and on middle and leg, played from well within the crease towards mid-on for a single
opens the face and guides it towards short third man for one more
full and flighted, pushed towards long-on for a single
punched towards long-on for a single
full and outside off, slightly uppish as Smith whips it to midwicket

great over from Tait ends with the reward of Uthappa's wicket, full and wide 145 kph delivery, Uthappa throws his bat at it in an attempt to blaze it through the off side, off the edge to the keeper, strike-rate below 70 this innings, where's the big-hitting finisher Pune splashed 2 million or so for?
a low full toss outside off, 143 kph, Uthappa pushes this towards mid-off, a dot ball
full and outside off, 138kph, punched towards sweeper cover by Smith
polite lbw appeal this time, a 145.6 kph yorker this time, that hits him low on the pads but was going well down the leg side,Uthappa points out to Smith that it swing in a long way
bouncer this time, 143kph, and well outside off, Uthappa goes for the pull, off the bottom edge towards long-on
Uthappa really had no clue about that, a 142 kph length ball that he wanted to hoick over midwicket, doesn't get anywhere near it
big appeal for lbw as Uthappa misses on the reverse-sweep, umpire's not interested, struck outside off
eased towards long-on for an ambled single
a wristy stroke from him, picking the ball from outside off and working it towards midwicket
end of the entertainment from Majumdar, again he backed away from the stumps, Botha saw it and fired in a 98.4kph yorker, Majumdar can't get bat on it and that thuds into the legstump
lovely hit from Majumdar, waltzes down the track and intentionally launches it over extra cover, he had moved beyond leg before playing that stroke, gets it well wide of long-off
he skips down the track and looks to launch the ball over long-off, outside edges it
six more, comfortably the most productive over for Pune this, flighted on middle and leg and he charges out before clobbering it over deep midwicket
thumps this between midwicket and long-on for two more, good running there
a six, at last, Pune need more boundaries, a lot more, Majumdar gets on his knee and muscles that over long-on
driven firmly to cover
full and outside off, went for the paddle sweep, but the ball sneaks under his bat and towards the keeper
flighted and full, powered towards deep extra cover, but the boundary prove elusive
short of a length and going down, batsman had jumped wide of the stumps, pushed towards cover
fuller this time, on middle and leg, punched towards mid-on
short of length ball sliding down leg, helped towards backward square leg
shortish ball, 122.6kph, around off stump, played off the back foot towards mid-on
skips away from leg stump and drives it towards sweeper cover
short of length ball outside off, helped towards short third man
fuller and outside off, steered to short third man, where Tait fields and prevents the single
just back of a length, flat-batted towards deep square leg
another slower one from Binny, slammed towards wide long-on but can't find the boundary
short of length ball and outside off, looks to guide it down to third man but can't connect
another legspinner from Binny, well outside off, that is driven towards sweeper cover for a single
angling in and that is tucked towards midwicket for a single
a length ball is defended back towards the bowler, should have been a dot ball but the bowler messes up a regulation stop to conceded a run
batsman back away and gets a thick outside edge as he looks to loft the ball over extra cover, he was down the track though the keeper is standing up
on the pads, calmly worked towards deep square leg, no power on that shot, giving the batsmen time to take two
short of length ball is worked to the leg side, more than four overs of dot balls already
length ball outside off, opens the face to guide the ball towards backward point
that was well down the leg side, keeper Yagnik moves across quickly to collect
helps this to fine leg for a single, Trivedi's first over this
full and outside off, worked towards sweeper cover for a single
worked towards midwicket this time by Uthappa

huge appeal for lbw, a back of the hand slower ball, like a legspinner to his Karnataka team-mate Robin Uthappa, who misses it and is struck on the pads, that looked out, was going to hit the leg stump, perhaps the umpire thought there was an inside-edge
punched towards cover for a single this time
Binny bowls this fuller, defended by Majumdar

Stuart Binny strikes first ball, Clarke is gone this time, he doesn't take a big stride forward as he looks to push a short of length ball to the off side, struck on the inside of his front pad, that was headed for leg, Clarke is on his way, the experiment to open with two of their slower, more experienced batsmen hasn't quite worked
full ball is squeezed out towards the leg side by Uthappa

full ball 145.4 kph, an inside-edge towards short fine leg for a single, Clarke rushes through for the run and as he makes his ground, the throw hits his bat and runs away for a boundary, five runs for Pune, one way they can get a move one, Clarke has a slightly sheepish grin at getting the bonus runs

Ganguly's innings is over, another bouncer does the job, that was too quick for Ganguly to pull, the ball flies high towards square leg, Ankeet Chavan runs back to get under that one and pouch that safely, 14 off 18 today
148.1kph from Tait, that one thuds into Clarke's thigh pad, rolls towards the square leg umpire
Ganguly skips beyond leg and chops the ball towards deep backward point
Ganguly was moving away from leg, Tait bowled a slower one outside off, Ganguly can't reach it
two more to Clarke, this time towards deep backward square leg

dropped, Dada survives, he was horribly uncomfortable pulling a sharp bouncer from Watson, Ganguly takes his eyes off the ball as he plays the shot, a top edge towards deep fine leg, where Tait puts in a dive but can't hang on to the ball, he reached there in time, but the ball doesn't go into his palm hitting closer to the wrist
stays in the crease and works it towards midwicket
backs away and thumps a fullish ball towards mid-on for a single

another lbw appeal, Watson has his hands on his head after the umpire turns it down, a short of length ball that is angling in, strikes Clarke on the knee roll, think there was enough doubt that that would miss leg stump
first ball is a low full toss that is tucked to midwicket
straighter one, length ball carries on towards middle stump, slapped off the back foot towards point
big appeal for lbw, Ganguly went for the sweep but seemed to have been struck just outside the line of off stump
nearly gone there, the ball loops between backward point and cover, not as well hit as Ganguly would have liked, neither Watson nor Dravid could get there in time
down the leg side, Ganguly have backed away from the stumps,powerfully chops this past point for four
on the pads, worked towards deep midwicket
defends the first ball to the off side
length ball heading for middle, worked towards deep square leg for a single to end the over
fuller and on middle and off, pushed back to the bowler
slightly shorter this time and slanting towards middle and leg, slower one from Watson, Clarke shuffles across and guides that fine towards fine leg for four
full and heading for middle, 137kph, punched towards mid-on, dot ball
pitched up and this is worked towards deep backward square leg
starts with a ball just outside off, slapped towards backward point by Ganguly
and it will just be one from the over, solid start from Tait, Clarke defends a length ball towards cover
defended back to the left of the bowler, 147kph this time from Tait
fuller from Tait, 145.6kph, Clarke gets behind the line and defends
defended towards the off side  by Clarke
Ganguly looks to pull this short of length ball powerfully, timing is off and the ball rolls towards midwicket

Tait begins with a back of length ball on middle stump, defended from the crease towards mid-on, Ganguly wants one, Clarke doesn't, Ganguly runs almost halfway through before being forced to turn back
shifts to an outside off line, Ganguly tips it towards cover and takes a single
worked towards midwicket for a single, good over so far
length ball on leg stump, just pitched outside leg, lbw appeal turned down after Ganguly misses the sweep
too far down the leg side, Ganguly wanted to sweep that hard to fine leg but misses
Dada charges down the track and defends to the leg side, Chavan keeps it on a leg-stump line
clipped towards midwicket for a single
starts with a length ball on the pads, a leg-bye towards backward square leg
wow, that is pure power from Watson, Smith drops it short and it spins away, Watson doesn't care as he murders it past long-on for four to bring up the win, Watson has made 90 out of 126 here
Shah clips it to midwicket for a single
clipped to midwicket by Shah for a single
a shortish ball is slammed towards midwicket, reaches the fielder on the bounce
poor delivery down the leg side, easily put away to the fine leg boundary
pitched up and well outside off, a little turn for Clarke, Watson was looking to go over extra cover but gets it towards deep backward square leg
follows the batsman down the leg side, tucked towards midwicket
defended off the front foot

short and outside off, sits up for Watson, who smashes it wide of sweeper cover for four more, how would this match have played out if that smith catch had been ruled out? No one else looking comfortable on this track
again Shah using a tactic he has employed a lot, jumping beyond the leg stump and drives it through the off side
full again and on legstump as Shah skipped away from the stumps, driven towards mid-off
flighted and full, outside off, squeezed towards point, 'no run there,' shouts the keeper
pitched up and driven towards long-off for a single
pulled towards midwicket for a single
a flighted delivery is defended
Clarke gets a wicket as he so often does, Menaria looks to hammer this over midwicket but can't get the power behind it and it is falls to the waiting Manhas, too little for Pune though, surely
defended to the leg side this time
defends this off the front foot
full ball on the pads, whipped towards deep midwicket
another boundary for Watson, he's playing on a different surface from everyone else clearly, thumps this length ball towards cow corner for four more
Menaria pulls, his timing has been awry all innings today, but he's doing whats required for Rajasthan
a bouncer outside off, Menaria bends his knee to get out of the way of that
no risks from Watson, an on-drive for a single
flicked it behind square leg for one more
length ball is chopped towards short third
pitched up, and long-on has more work to do, Watson striking at around 180 when pretty much everyone else has struggled on this pitch
again on the pads, clipped behind square leg for another single
on the leg stump, punched to long-on for one more
short and outside off, Menaria powers it towards deep point, Parnell comes in off the rope but not quickly enough to collect it, it lands a few yards short of him
full delivery again,powered towards long-on for a single
full ball is punched towards long-on for one more
drops it short, that's all Watto needs, he launches that over the sightscreen, immense power from Watson
flat and quick, defended by Watson
trying to muscle that through the off side, inside-edges it behind square leg
outside off and that is chopped towards deep backward point for two
a yorker is drilled to long-on for a single
tossed up and Watson looks for the booming drive, beaten by the turn
Watson has used this stroke a lot today, a glide to third man for a single, it was a length ball angling in towards off, not much room for Watto, but he had no trouble with that
drops it behind square on the leg side and pinches a single
short of length and just outside off, steered towards the fielder at third man for one more
no timing at all as Menaria jumps beyond leg and looks to power the ball over cover, it dribbles towards sweeper cover
length ball is drilled towards long-on by Watson
length ball is guided towards third man for an easy single

Watson is laughing after he hits another six, he gets to his half-century as well with that, it was a terrible ball from Nehra, length and down the leg side, powered over the backward square leg boundary for six
way outside off stump, Watson has to reach across for that, a controlled cut sends it past a diving Smith for four
punched off the backfoot towards sweeper cover, calls for two but has to settle for one
short of length ball is pulled towards deep midwicket
poor delivery this, when you are defending a small score, you just can't bowl these, down the leg side, helped along to fine leg for four
Watson gets on the front foot and defends this one
length ball is pushed towards long-on for a single
chopped towards deep point for a single
short of length on off stump, pushed towards the bowler
defended off the front foot to the off side
short of length and outside off, steered down to third man
short of length ball is pushed towards mid-off
outside off and Menaria slashes and misses at that one
short ball just outside off, 136.6 kph, Menaria sways out of the line of that one
outside edge outside off, streaky from Menaria,no footwork at all as he pokes at a short of length ball, enough on it to beat the keeper
eased toward backward point by Maneria off the backfoot
length ball on the leg stump, pushed towards long-on
defended towards cover by Watson

Dravid is completely fooled by that slower one from Parnell, he was almost through the shot before the ball arrives, he tries to check his shot, but the ball loops off the bottom of his bat towards mid-off, no need for superhuman efforts to catch this one, Clarke clasps a simple chance, there's a big delay as the umpires check whether Parnell overstepped, it's tight but the umpires are satisifed
steers it to third man for a single

full and on legstump 142.2kph, superb stroke from Watson, doesn't try to power it, just closes the face to steer the ball past deep square leg, sensational timing on that, Rajasthan have already hit as many boundaries as Pune managed in their entire innings
short of length ball on the legstump, tucked towards backward square leg
guides the ball from outside off towards third man, no-risk single there
short ball is pulled towards fine leg by Dravid
short of length and another pull from Watson, this time towards deep midwicket
short ball down the leg side, a muscular pull from Watson, that races to the deep backward square leg boundary, Pune can't afford these loose deliveries
punched towards mid-on, bit of hesitation before they go through for a single
on the pads, and this is put away by Dravid, clipped towards deep backward square leg, Murali Kartik puts in a dive and gets his hand on the ball but can't prevent the boundary
short of length and on the pads, worked towards wide mid-on
solidly defended towards cover by Dravid to end the over
slaps this towards midwicket and gets two
short of length and steered to third man for a single
pitched up and that is easy for Watson, clubs it towards long-on for four
worked towards midwicket this time
outside off and guides it towards third man

whoah, Steve Smith has nearly pulled off the best piece of outfielding, possibly ever, Watson hammered that one towards long-on, where Smith ran across to try take an over head catch, he realises he was going over the rope, so he tosses the ball up, but he can't toss it up back into the field of play, Smith is behind the rope as he jumps and pushes the ball back into play, then takes the catch on the third attempt, he was in the air when he touched the ball the second time, so am not entirely sure why that was given not out
defends it towards extra cover
the arm ball, just outside off stump, steers it to third man for four
flighted and that is driven towards extra cover
a trademark Watson stroke, gets the front let out of the way, and hammers that over long-on for six, he's brutal with that stroke against the spinners
shortish outside off, chopped towards backward point
134.6 kph, short of length ball to end the over, Dravid looks to flat bat it but bottom edges it to the right of the bowler, just one off the over and the wicket of Rahane
Dravid is beaten outside off as he wafts at a length delivery that moves away a hint
edged towards backward square leg for a single, Watson is off the mark

outstanding catch from Smith, just what Pune needed, an innocuous delivery outside off, Rahane cuts it slightly uppishly, hadn't counted on the flying Smith, who dives full-length to his right to pouch that inches off the ground, ridiculously good from Smith, Rahane won't be getting the orange cap today then
fuller and outside off, defended to the off side by Rahane
driven on the up towards cover, can't beat the fielder
137.6 kph bouncer to end the over, Dravid goes for the hook but is beaten
141kph on the leg stump, Dravid looks to clip it to square leg but is struck high on the pad
length ball outside off, looks to slash it towards backward point but he is beaten
keeps at leg stump, tucked towards square leg by Dravid
these are the sort of deliveries Rajasthan rarely provided, down the leg side, easy to put away to fine leg for four
the first ball is squeezed to the leg side, Dravid sets off for a single, Parnell is after the ball, kicks it towards the stumps but Dravid has got back in time
